criteria.criterion: A code-review run over a diff seeded with an unlocked-twin race surfaces a Pass-1 `concurrency` finding; checked by the standing eval `rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency` passing its gate.

The `concurrency` overlay fires deterministically from diff content via the committed high-precision token trigger (added and removed lines), and appears in the base reviewer's overlay catalog for escalation; checked by unit tests over corpus-derived diff hunks. The committed-trigger unit tests NAME the coverage split.
A project can extend a built-in overlay's trigger vocabulary and `applies_to` globs through `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` without code changes; checked by unit tests with a project-overlay fixture.

rebar's own `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` carries the noisy-tier concurrency vocabulary as the documented worked example, and the two-layer trigger design is documented in `docs/llm-framework.md`; checked by a config-effect test proving a project token (`index.lock`) triggers the overlay under this repo's effective routing but not under committed-only routing.
The committed routing entry for `concurrency` is advisory (`block_threshold` 0.95, `blocking_enabled` false); checked by a unit assertion on `threshold_for("concurrency")`.
